visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: White, 48px padding; one slide per view, six slides alternating a captioned full-width photo and a text quote (serif quotation, short orange rule, bold name and position); orange outline pagination dots centred, play/pause and prev/next arrows right.
visualCharacteristics.variantRationale: One slide per view mixing captioned full-width photos and text quotes, outline dots, play/pause and arrows. carousel-news is a 3-up news card slider (<80%)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: One-slide-per-view carousel with dots, prev/next and play/pause; autoplay is off when the user prefers reduced motion

contentPattern.summary: Interactive slider; quotations stay in their slides because they are inside an interactive component
contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: [image | caption] for photos, [empty | quotation paragraph(s), bold name, position] for quotes

blockContent.description: Six slides: photo "Endo Axiom co-founders..." ; quote Dr Nicholas Hunt ; photo "DDI-Pharos MOU Signing Ceremony" ; quote Prof Michael Kassiou ; photo "Kinoxis Therapeutics partnership with Boehringer Ingelheim" ; quote Prof Mark Scott / Carousel, 4 captioned photo slides: ddi-ecr-winners.jpeg "2023 DDI ECR Award winners" (alt "4 DDI ECR winners"); ddi-phd-workshop.jpeg ./images/b0e39f63e68a10a261949d7696a6d671.jpg "'I have a PhD now what' workshop"; ddi-lecture.jpeg "DDI ECR Symposium" (alt "DDI lecture event"); ddi-ecr-symposium.jpeg "DDI ECR Symposium". Unlisted images use source URLs under https://www.sydney.edu.au/content/dam/corporate/images/research/drug-discovery-initiative/
blockContent.notes: Six rows in source order. Photo slides: image | caption paragraph. Quote slides: empty image cell | quotation paragraph (not a heading) + attribution name (strong) + position. Quotations stay inside the carousel.

reuseGuidance: Use for a one-slide-per-view gallery of photos and/or quotations. Photo row: image | caption. Quote row: leave the image cell empty; put the quotation, then the name in bold, then the position as separate paragraphs.
usageDescription: One-slide-per-view carousel with dots, prev/next and play/pause; autoplay is off when the user prefers reduced motion
